name: Aku Chuunyuu -Kimi ni Sasageru Akui no Tamashii-
original_name: 悪注入-君に捧げる悪意の魂-
source:
Main character watches a meteorite fall at night and walks to the collapse spot. But he only finds a gothic girl Lilim at that place. Lilim says that she is a devil who arrives to the human world to  become a full-fledged person. Protagonist can't help the temptation to teach her the obscene side of humanity. But the story takes an unexpected turn as the wings of destiny approach.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天夜里，主人公看到一颗陨石坠落，便动身前往坠落地点。然而他在那里发现的，只有一名哥特风少女莉莉姆。莉莉姆声称自己是一名恶魔，此次来到人类世界，是为了成长为独当一面的魔人。主人公无法抗拒诱惑，开始教她见识人性淫靡的一面。然而随着命运的羽翼逐渐逼近，故事也迎来了意想不到的转折。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
